out_of_scope: Grid stability: frequency and voltage control, grid forming inverters and protection for hours with no diesel running
Land ownership, permits and the environmental review
Site layout, shading, soil and access for construction
Shipping to the island, local labour and construction time
Financing terms, tariffs, subsidies and who pays
Demand growth beyond the growth case, and new loads such as electric boats
Battery ageing beyond the replacement rule, and salt air corrosion
Diesel price risk beyond the sensitivity table
Diesel overhaul and engine replacement costs, which grow with engine hours

site_land_ha.label: press
site_land_ha.note: PLN Indonesia Power plans about 9 hectares of land on Legon Bajak for the Karimunjawa PV plant (Tribun Jateng, interview with PLN IP engineering; the same article says permits are in process)

pv_mwdc_per_ha.label: paper
pv_mwdc_per_ha.note: Bolinger and Bolinger, Land Requirements for Utility-Scale PV, IEEE Journal of Photovoltaics, doi:10.1109/JPHOTOV.2021.3136805, Section IV: median power density of fixed-tilt US plants; low latitude sites need less row spacing, so this may overstate the land

reference_pv_kwp.label: paper
reference_pv_kwp.note: Hiron 2021 design: 3889 modules of 320 Wp (p11), 0.99 MW AC; its battery size is not stated in kWh, so the check runs PV only

diesel_must_run_units.label: assumed
diesel_must_run_units.note: reserve case: one diesel unit runs in every hour as a spinning reserve

near_tie_frac.label: assumed
near_tie_frac.note: designs whose LCOE is within this share of the least LCOE count as a near tie

diesel_unit_kw_alt.label: paper
diesel_unit_kw_alt.note: Hiron 2021 prints two diesel fleet sizes: 2 x 2.7 MW on p1 and in Table 1, and 2 x 1.8 MW on p7 (the field section, with the feeder voltages); the main study uses 1.8 MW units, and this check reruns the design search with 2.7 MW units

battery_duration_h_alt.label: assumed
battery_duration_h_alt.note: check case: battery energy in kWh is 8 times its power rating in kW instead of the main 4, so the power rating is halved; this check reruns the design search with that battery
